author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 여름철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수백 마리
habitat: 해안과 내륙의 바위 절벽, 암벽·암초·벼랑의 틈, 건물 틈
summary: 해안과 내륙의 바위 절벽에 사는 흔한 텃새로, 기후에 따라 옮겨 다니기도 하고 한곳에 머물기도 한다. 암수가 저마다 홀로 지내며 일정한 세력권을 차지하고, 갈라진 암벽이나 암초의 틈, 벼랑의 구멍, 건물 틈에서 산다. 5~6월에 알 5~6개를 낳으며, 곤충과 이각류·십각류 같은 갑각류, 복족류 연체동물을 먹는다. 국내 전역에 살고 국외에서는 일본, 에스파냐에 분포한다.

points.en: deep blue upper breast and back
blue-black lower breast, wings and tail

sexes.male: 머리·멱·윗가슴·등은 남청색, 아랫가슴·날개·꼬리는 청흑색, 배는 적갈색이며 부리는 검은빛이다.
sexes.female: 등은 회갈색, 꼬리는 흑갈색, 배는 어두운 황갈색이며 부리는 갈색빛이다.

art.subject: Blue Rock Thrush (Monticola solitarius philippensis), adult male, as seen on Korean rocky coasts: head, throat, upper breast, mantle and back deep cobalt blue; breast blue darkening to blue-black where it meets the chestnut on the lower breast; wings and tail blackish-blue; belly, flanks and undertail coverts deep chestnut. Bill slender, blackish. Brown eye. Dark brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a rock ledge, side view
art.scene: Korean rocky sea cliff with cracks and crevices above the shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a rock: deep blue head, throat, upper breast and back, blue-black lower breast, wings and tail, chestnut belly, slender blackish bill, dark brown legs
adult female, side view perched: grey-brown upperparts with a faint blue tinge, blackish-brown tail, buff-brown underparts densely scaled with dark crescents, brownish bill
art.build: Medium-sized, slim, long-billed thrush, about 25cm, a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul; upright stance on rocks and roofs, often bobbing and flicking the tail. Bill straight and slender, about as long as the head. Legs medium length, dark brown. Wings fairly long. Tail medium length, square. Flight low and direct between rocks; sings from cliff ledges and rooftops.
avoid: Do not paint the whole underparts blue; East Asian males have a chestnut belly.
Do not paint chestnut on the throat or face; the chestnut starts on the lower breast.
Do not paint a short, stubby or yellow bill.
Do not paint white wing patches or white in the tail.
